name: @adhd/sox-analysis
description: Batch derivation over a corpus — clustering (density-clustering, in-process JS), near-dup detection, importance + link scoring, and a suite of pure graph algorithms (topoSort, criticalPath, detectCycles, packBatches). No CorpusBackend wrapper: DB-integrated functions take VectorBackend + GraphBackend directly.

concerns: clustering / community detection (density-clustering, in-process JS — NOT a SQLite extension)
near-dup detection (NearDupPair with near_dup / candidate / distinct status)
auto-linking (similarity-threshold edge creation, RELATES_TO by default)
pure topoSort + wave assignment (Kahn BFS, cycle detection + recovery)
detectCycles (all cycles, not just first — for user-facing error messages)
packBatches (bin-packing with submodular shared cost; algorithm auto-selects by N + DAG structure)
detectDAGStructure (forest / series-parallel / general — determines packBatches algorithm)
invariants: operates over a corpus (batch), never per-query — analysis functions are not on the hot query path
clustering uses an existing JS lib (density-clustering / hdbscanjs) — NOT hand-rolled DBSCAN/HDBSCAN
all DB-integrated functions take (VectorBackend, GraphBackend) directly — no CorpusBackend wrapper
similarity-based outputs (clusters, near-dup pairs, link scores) MUST record the modelId they were computed under — re-clustering after a model migration is required
computeImportance / buildAutoLinks are incremental by default ([def:deterministic-first] — processes only un-scored nodes)
topoSort / criticalPath / detectCycles accept a caller-supplied adjacency function (getEdges) so they work over any graph representation, not just graph-store
packBatches shared resource cost is submodular (union cost) — shared resources are paid once per batch; callers must not compute additive per-item resource cost
